tagline: A community bank with a heritage of service and strength in regional U.S. West Coast markets.
hero_kpi_rationale: Key indicator of credit quality reflecting a significant increase in nonaccrual loans in 2025 (+414.2%), revealing a notable deterioration in loan portfolio quality that justifies a provision for credit losses of $52.6M and heightened credit risk monitoring.

kpis.name: Nonaccrual loans
kpis.explanation: Amount of loans where repayment is past due or deemed uncertain.
kpis.description: Nonaccrual loans increased significantly, rising from $4,079M to $20,976M between 2024 and 2025.
kpis.signal: Sharp increase in nonaccrual loans in 2025

kpis.name: Allowance for credit losses
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover potential losses on loans.
kpis.description: The allowance for credit losses totaled $52.6M at end of 2025, reflecting prudent credit risk management.
kpis.signal: High level of credit risk coverage

kpis.name: Annual provision for credit losses
kpis.explanation: Amount added in 2025 to the provision for credit losses.
kpis.description: The bank added $1.5M to its provision in 2025, despite a sharp increase in nonaccrual loans.
kpis.signal: Moderate annual charge despite higher nonaccrual loans

kpis.name: Total loan portfolio
kpis.explanation: Total value of loans originated by the bank.
kpis.description: Total loan portfolio stood at $4,783.27M at end of 2025, primarily focused on commercial real estate and business loans.
kpis.signal: Large loan portfolio concentrated on real estate and businesses

kpis.name: Business loans
kpis.explanation: Loans to businesses, including industrial and commercial real estate.
kpis.description: Business loans represent $3,910.67M of the portfolio, or more than 80% of total loans.
kpis.signal: Primary segment of the loan portfolio

kpis.name: Residential real estate loans
kpis.explanation: Loans for home purchase or construction.
kpis.description: Residential real estate loans totaled $358.834M at end of 2025, representing approximately 7.5% of total portfolio.

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.068B in latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.description: Diluted EPS extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Diluted EPS of $1.96 in latest fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Interest rate risk
